raw:
Daniil Kvyat finished second or third once in 2015: second at the Hungarian Grand Prix, where Vettel won and Ricciardo finished third.

I checked the top 10 of all 19 races on the 2015 calendar. Kvyat's other finishes were 4th (Monaco, Belgium, Mexico), 5th (Russia), 6th (Britain, Singapore), 7th (Brazil), 9th (Malaysia, Bahrain, Canada) and 10th (Spain, Abu Dhabi). He was outside the top 10 in China, Australia, Italy's top 10 had him 10th, and Austria, Japan, the United States and Italy had no second- or third-place finish. There was no German Grand Prix in 2015.

ANSWER: 1
